subject: English
question_text: Write a summary of the above passage in your own words.
guide_solution: Yuri Gagarin was the first human to travel into space and move round the earth in 1961. He was a Russian astronaut. He was born on March 9, 1934. After completing his graduation, he took a training as Soviet Air Cadet at a local club. He again graduated from a technical school and was recruited in the Soviet Army. Then he was selected for Soviet Space programme to travel into space.
